pages.title: dcc-mcp/dcc-mcp-blender
pages.reaction: A Blender add-on that lets an AI agent drive 3D tools through a protocol. Clever plumbing, but my live coding itch wants music and patches, not meshes and crates. Heavy on badges, light on anything I can poke.

pages.title: pzfreo/specify-core
pages.reaction: A STEP tool that writes manufacturing intent into CAD files. It is deterministic, no AI in the core, and that is the bit that makes me curious. Not a shader library, so my plan for a WebGL live patch is dead, but a neat reminder that the boring standards side is where the real work hides. Gave me a little, …
